name: ui-confirm
prompt: Short bright UI confirmation click, a clean fingertip tap on a wooden button with a soft high snap

name: ui-back
prompt: Soft low UI back click, a dull wooden tap with a slightly descending tone

name: ui-focus
prompt: Very short faint UI focus tick, a gentle fingernail tap on a plastic key

name: invalid
prompt: Short low error buzz, a dull double buzzer tone signalling a rejected action

name: dive-committed
prompt: Quick whoosh of a goalkeeper diving sideways, fabric and gloves cutting through air with a soft snap

name: kick
prompt: Powerful soccer boot striking a leather football, deep thump with a sharp leather snap

name: goal
prompt: Football ripping into the back of the goal net with a swish, followed by a roaring stadium crowd cheer

name: save
prompt: Goalkeeper gloves slapping a football away with a sharp padded impact, followed by a short crowd gasp

name: offtarget
prompt: Football thudding into the advertising boards behind the goal, followed by a disappointed crowd groan

name: whistle-start
prompt: Single sharp referee whistle blast, crisp pea whistle at full volume

name: whistle-end
prompt: Referee whistle signalling full time, one long blast followed by two short blasts

name: win
prompt: Stadium crowd erupting in celebration, sustained cheers and applause with a rising swell

name: lose
prompt: Disappointed stadium crowd, a low collective sigh fading into sparse quiet applause

name: achievement
prompt: Bright celebratory chime, a metallic bell ding with a short sparkling shimmer

name: tick
prompt: Single short clock tick, a crisp mechanical click like a countdown timer
